verdict.rationale: Datalab documents converting images and PDFs into Markdown, HTML or JSON, with an 'accurate' processing mode, multi-language support, and Track Changes extraction from scans. That shows it OCRs scanned and photographed input, but no evidence speaks to how accurate that OCR is on degraded inputs. Missing for 10: evidence of handling skewed or rotated pages, stamps or seals, and low-quality or photographed scans, plus any independent accuracy corroboration on scanned documents.
